title: Tim Taylor's secret space program and timeline adjusting

tellings.quote: operative Tim Taylor. In the book, Pulka claims that Taylor was part of a secret space program involving UFOs.

plain: A government operative named Tim Taylor was part of a secret space programme involving UFOs, a programme the story links to adjusting timelines. Michels tells this from American Cosmic, a book by the scholar Diana Pasulka, in which she makes this claim about Taylor. If true, it would mean the government runs a hidden space effort built on UFO technology.
